## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change makes possible. Link the issue; use `Closes #number` only when its acceptance criteria are met.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. For Windows behavior, include exact build/architecture and a sanitized verification record. State what was not checked.

## Risks and recovery

Describe relevant compatibility, unsafe-code, permission or recovery implications. Write `None beyond existing scope` when appropriate.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope follows the issue and milestone gates.
- [ ] Required checks pass on the current commit.
- [ ] New non-trivial behavior has meaningful tests; UI/platform claims have evidence.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility claims match the implementation.
- [ ] No secrets, identifiers, raw dumps or unreviewed binaries are included.
- [ ] Contributions are signed off and dependencies have compatible licenses.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the workflow.
